meta.rate_note: PLACEHOLDER rates. Indicative Dubai mid-market figures, AED, supply and install, excl. VAT. Nobody has priced this villa: these stand in for a contractor's rates and are not quotations. Edit and re-run scripts/boq.py.

items.desc: Excavation for foundations, average 1.5 m deep, incl. disposal
items.rule: Ground-floor footprint outside the basement x 1.35 working-space factor x 1.5 m depth. No soil report: depth assumed.

items.desc: Basement excavation to about 3.7 m deep, incl. disposal
items.rule: Basement plan area 85.8 m2 x 1.25 working space x depth. Basement floor level (-3.00 m) is assumed.

items.desc: Temporary shoring to the basement excavation
items.rule: Length of the basement outer walls. Method not designed.

items.desc: Backfilling and compaction in layers with approved material
items.rule: Foundation excavation less footings and tie beams, plus the working space around the basement.

items.desc: Anti-termite treatment under slabs and footings
items.rule: Ground-slab area + 15 %.

items.desc: Blinding concrete 75 mm under footings, tie beams and the basement raft
items.rule: 37 pads + tie-beam length x 0.45 m + basement plan area.

items.desc: Reinforced concrete C40 SRC in isolated footings (37 nr assumed, 1.8 x 1.8 x 0.6 m)
items.rule: One column per 9 m2 of footprint; pad size assumed. Replace with the structural design.

items.desc: Reinforced concrete C40 SRC in tie beams 250 x 600 mm
items.rule: Under every ground-floor wall 190 mm or thicker (134.4 m) x section.

items.desc: Reinforced concrete basement raft, 400 mm (assumed)
items.rule: Basement plan area 85.8 m2 x assumed thickness.

items.desc: Reinforced concrete basement retaining walls, 300 mm (assumed)
items.rule: Outer basement walls 45.0 m x 3.30 m x assumed thickness.

items.desc: Formwork to footings, tie beams and basement walls
items.rule: Sides of pads, both sides of tie beams and of the basement walls.

items.desc: Reinforcement to substructure (high-yield bars, cut, bent, fixed)
items.rule: Ratios: footings 80, tie beams 130, raft 110, retaining walls 140 kg/m3.

items.desc: Basement tanking: waterproof membrane with protection to raft and walls
items.rule: Raft area + outside face of the basement walls.

items.desc: Bituminous waterproofing to footings and tie beams
items.rule: Sides and tops of footings, sides of tie beams.

items.desc: Slab on grade 150 mm C30 with mesh, on polythene and compacted fill
items.rule: Ground slab area outside the basement, measured over walls. Thickness assumed.

items.desc: Reinforced concrete C40 in columns 250 x 600 mm (37 nr assumed)
items.rule: 37 columns x section x 6.55 m (ground slab to roof slab).

items.desc: Reinforced concrete C40 in two round columns, 280 mm diameter, living room
items.rule: The two round columns drawn on the brochure plan, floor to slab.

items.desc: Reinforced concrete C40 in drop beams 250 x 500 mm below slab
items.rule: Along walls 190 mm or thicker: 134.4 m at first floor + 62.9 m at roof.

items.desc: Reinforced concrete C40 in the slab over the basement, 250 mm solid
items.rule: Basement plan area 85.8 m2 x assumed thickness.

items.desc: Reinforced concrete C40 in first-floor slab and terraces, 250 mm solid
items.rule: Measured slab area 371.3 m2 (void over the entrance lobby excluded) x assumed thickness.

items.desc: Reinforced concrete C40 in roof slab, 250 mm solid
items.rule: Measured roof area 352.5 m2 x assumed thickness.

items.desc: Reinforced concrete in two stair flights (38 risers)
items.rule: Plan area of the two flights 14.8 m2 x 0.25 m average.

items.desc: Reinforced concrete lift shaft walls, three storeys
items.rule: Shaft about 1.4 x 1.3 m inside, 200 mm walls, basement to roof plus pit. Sizes assumed.

items.desc: Formwork to columns, beams, slab soffits and stairs
items.rule: Column perimeters x height + beam sides and soffits + slab soffit area + stair soffit x 1.4.

items.desc: Reinforcement to superstructure
items.rule: Ratios: columns 190, beams 160, slabs 105, stairs 120 kg/m3.

items.desc: External walls: insulated (thermal) blockwork
items.rule: Length x height to slab soffit, all door and window openings deducted. No deduction for columns or beams (not designed). Any wall above ground with a face to the outside.

items.desc: Internal walls: 200 mm hollow concrete block
items.rule: Length x height to slab soffit, all door and window openings deducted. No deduction for columns or beams (not designed). Drawn 190 mm or thicker.

items.desc: Internal walls: 150 mm hollow concrete block
items.rule: Length x height to slab soffit, all door and window openings deducted. No deduction for columns or beams (not designed). Drawn 145 to 190 mm.

items.desc: Internal partitions: 100 mm hollow concrete block
items.rule: Length x height to slab soffit, all door and window openings deducted. No deduction for columns or beams (not designed). Drawn under 145 mm.

items.desc: Basement internal walls: 200 mm hollow concrete block
items.rule: Length x height, door openings deducted.

items.desc: Parapet upstands, 500 mm high, to roof edges
Precast or in-situ RC lintels over openings
items.rule: Opening width + 200 mm bearing each end, every opening.

items.desc: Roof system: membrane waterproofing, 50 mm insulation, screed to falls and protection
items.rule: Roof slab area.

items.desc: Waterproofing upstand to parapets, 300 mm
items.rule: Inside length of parapets.

items.desc: Waterproofing to first-floor terraces
items.rule: Terrace slab areas as modelled (their true extent is assumed).

items.desc: Waterproofing to wet-area floors with 300 mm upstand
items.rule: Wet-room floor area + perimeter x 0.3 m.

items.desc: Travertine-look stone facing to the two side walls and their fins
items.rule: Outside face of the two long side walls, both storeys, + 25 % for the fins that run past the glass lines and the returns. The material is read from the brochure pictures (assumed).

items.desc: External cement render, three coats, to other outside walls and parapets
items.rule: Outside faces of the remaining external walls 59.5 m2 + both faces and top of parapets 44.0 m2.

items.desc: Internal cement plaster 15 mm to walls

items.desc: Emulsion paint system to plastered walls

items.desc: Porcelain wall tiling full height to wet rooms
